question: Does Quezon advisory label “Upper Kilbay – Catabangan” refer to the same cross-region river system as the Bicol “Lower Kilbay Catabangan” watercourse and Kilbay-Catabangan principal basin?
purpose: Cross-check the Quezon advisory label against official PAGASA, DPWH, and EMB Bicol records while retaining exact route, continuity, and basin boundaries as unresolved.

findings.evidence: Quezon General Flood Advisory No. 14, issued 7 August 2026, lists “Upper Kilbay – Catabangan” among watercourses under Quezon. The advisory is time-bounded and has no route or geometry.
doesNotSupport: connection to the Camarines Sur watercourse
current flood status or fish occurrence

findings.evidence: Official PAGASA indexed PDF text for Region IV-A General Flood Advisory No. 7 (26 November 2025) lists “Upper Kilbay - Catabangan” under Quezon. The live PDF URL returned a later 2026 notice on 2026-11-01, so the historical text is not reproducible from the current file at that URL.
supports: independent official upper-reach wording and Quezon grouping
doesNotSupport: identity with the Bicol lower reach

findings.evidence: Official PAGASA indexed PDF text for Region V General Flood Advisory No. 8 (Final, 27 November 2025) lists “Lower Kilbay Catabangan” under Camarines Sur and says watercourses were no longer to be affected in that event. The live PDF URL returned a later 2026 notice on 2026-11-01, so the historical text is not reproducible from the current file at that URL.
supports: official lower-reach wording and Camarines Sur grouping
doesNotSupport: connection to the Quezon upper reach

findings.evidence: Annex D-2 row 170 lists “Kilbay-Catabangan” as a Region V principal river basin with reported area 285 sq km.

EMB Region V 2024 SoBER Table 4.3 lists “Kilbay-Katabanagan” in Camarines Sur as Class B, classified 1998 under DMC No. 1999-18. The EMB R5 official waterbody listing search text further names Del Gallego, Camarines Sur; the listing page was not directly accessible in this review.
supports: official Bicol spelling variant and historical classification context
Camarines Sur locality context from the EMB listing
doesNotSupport: equivalence with DPWH basin or Quezon upper reach

crosswalk.resolutionLevel: partial cross-region system-name candidate only; no reviewed source verifies channel continuity, exact reaches, or boundaries

nextActions: Seek route-scale official hydrography or an authorized basin technical description spanning the Quezon–Camarines Sur context before linking the upper/lower labels as one mapped system.
Review dated, station-resolved fish evidence for any verified reaches separately; do not transfer Camarines Sur observations to Quezon.
nonClaims: The DPWH-reported 285 sq km is not a basin polygon or river geometry.
The upper/lower naming and similar Bicol basin/waterbody names are a partial candidate, not proof that the reaches form one continuous mapped feature.
The 2025 PAGASA advisories are historical and are not current warnings.
No fish presence or absence, complete checklist, salinity, current water quality, safety, access, fishing permission, or diet/bait guidance is asserted.
